 Mahachandrakala Rasa available in the herbal decoction form. In orders to manage the female menstrual disorders, mahachandrakala rasa is known to be an effective medicine. It is quite good to manage the problems like regularities in periods, pain, heavy blood flow etc.

fullContent:
Mahachandrakala Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Basavarajiyam 
 Introduction 
 Mahachandrakala Rasa is a classical preparation in Ayurveda that is efficient medicine for bleeding problems. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Kantaloha Bhasma 
 Rasasindoora 
 Abhraka Bhasma 
 Parpataka 
 Guduchi Satwa 
 Pippali 
 Khuskhus 
 Anantamula 
 Chandana 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Mahachandrakala Rasa available in the herbal decoction form. It is used to manage the various bleeding disorders like hemorrhage, rectal bleeding, epistaxis, menstrual disorders etc. This medicine helps to reduce to heat in body which is main cause of bleeding diorders. It helps to pacify the vitiated pitta doshas and rakta dhatu in body. This medicine also works well to manage the urinary infections. Antimicrobial action is quite good to extrude the bacteria from urinary tract. It also helps to manage the various symptoms associated with the urinary tract d infections like painful urination, burning sensation when urinating, cloudy, bloody or frequent urination, inflammation of bladder, urinary incontinence etc. it also helps to manage the nausea, vomiting, muscles aches, abdominal cramps in urinary infections. In orders to manage the female menstrual disorders, mahachandrakala rasa is known to be an effective medicine. It is quite good to manage the problems like regularities in periods, pain, heavy blood flow etc. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 This is a useful medicine in bleeding disorders as Hemorrhage, Epistaxis and menstrual disorders. 
 Also good to use to relief from heat in the body. 
 It also relieves heart burn, thirst, urinary disorders and menorrhagia. 
 
 Dosage 
 Consume 10 grams in 25 doses along with Dhanyaka Kashaya (Decoction) mixed with sugar candy honey, draksharista (Fermentation of dry grapes) as directed by the Ayurvedic physician 
 Contraindications/Side Effects 
 Take under medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
